questions.text: What distinguishes Rust collections from many other data types?

answers.text: They store multiple values and can change size at runtime
They always have a fixed size known at compile time
They store only values of different types
They exist only on the stack

questions.explanation: Collections store sets of values, place data on the heap, and can have a size that is unknown at compile time and changes while the program runs.
